name: White blood cells
summary: White blood cells are the cells of your immune system. The count shows how many are in a set volume of blood.

high.meaning: A high count usually means the body is fighting an infection or reacting to stress or inflammation.

low.meaning: A low count can follow viral infections or be caused by some medicines. Some healthy people naturally have lower counts.
commonCauses: Natural variation, more common in people of African descent

sources.title: An epigenetic biomarker of aging for lifespan and healthspan
